sources.script: $i='https://cdn.kde.org/ci-builds/utilities/kate/master/windows/'; $h=(Invoke-WebRequest $i -UseBasicParsing).Content; $f=[regex]::Matches($h,'kate-master-(\d+)-windows-cl-msvc2022-x86_64\.exe(?!\.sha256)'); if($f.Count -eq 0){ exit 1 }; $b=($f | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Groups[1].Value } | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum; $u=$i + 'kate-master-' + $b + '-windows-cl-msvc2022-x86_64.exe'; try { $s=(Invoke-WebRequest ($u + '.sha256') -UseBasicParsing).Content.Trim(); 'sha256:' + ($s -split '\s+')[0].ToLower() } catch { }; 'version:master-' + $b; $u

sources.script: $h=@{ 'User-Agent'='AppInstaller'; 'Accept'='application/vnd.github.v3+json' }; $v=Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/microsoft/winget-pkgs/contents/manifests/g/Guru3D/RTSS' -Headers $h | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'dir' } | Sort-Object { $p=$_.name -split '\.'; [int]$p[0]*1000000 + [int]$p[1]*1000 + [int]($p[2] -replace '\D','') } | Select-Object -Last 1; $c=Invoke-RestMethod $v.url -Headers $h; $f=$c | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*.installer.yaml' } | Select-Object -First 1; $y=(Invoke-WebRequest $f.download_url -Headers $h -UseBasicParsing).Content; if($y -notmatch 'InstallerUrl:\s*(https://\S+)'){ exit 1 }; 'version:' + $v.name; $matches[1].Trim()
